1.source: Drafted from the public-domain King James Version in the simple-English style of this Bible.

verses.text: This is the divine unveiling of Jesus Christ! God gave Him this message to show His servants what must happen soon. Jesus sent His angel to explain these truths to His servant John.
John told everything he saw — the word of God and the message of Jesus Christ.
God will bless the one who reads the words of this prophecy out loud, and He will bless those who hear it and obey what is written, because the time is near.

John sends greetings to the seven churches in the province of Asia. Grace and peace to you from God! He is the One who is, who always was, and who is coming. Grace and peace from the sevenfold Holy Spirit before God's throne.

And grace from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness! Jesus is the firstborn raised from the dead. He rules as supreme King over all the kings of the earth! He loves us and washed away our sins with His own blood.
He has made us a kingdom and priests to serve His God and Father. To Him be glory and power forever and ever. Amen.
Look, He is coming with the clouds! Every eye will see Him, even those who pierced Him. All the peoples of the earth will cry because of Him. Yes, this is true. Amen.
I am the Alpha and the Omega — the beginning and the end, says the Lord God, the One who is, and who was, and who is coming, the All-Powerful.

I, John, am your brother. I share with you in the suffering, the kingdom, and the patient endurance that are ours in Jesus. I was on the island of Patmos because of the word of God and the message of Jesus.
On the Lord's day the Spirit took hold of me, and I heard behind me a loud voice like a trumpet.
It said: Write in a book what you see, and send it to the seven churches: Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea.
I turned around to see who was speaking to me. When I turned, I saw seven gold lampstands,
I saw someone like the Son of Man standing among the lampstands. He wore a long robe with a gold sash around His chest.
His head and hair were snow-white like pure wool. His eyes blazed like leaping flames of fire!
His feet glowed like bronze refined in a super-hot furnace. His booming voice roared like crashing ocean waterfalls!
He held seven stars securely in His right hand. A sharp, two-edged sword of truth proceeded out of His mouth! His face shone with the blinding brilliance of the midday sun.
When I saw Him, I collapsed at His feet like a dead man! He laid His right hand on me and said: "Do not fear! I am the First and the Last, the living Savior."
"I died on the cross, but look — I am alive forever and ever! I hold the keys of death and the grave!"
So write down what you have seen, what is happening now, and what will happen later.
Here is the meaning of the seven stars you saw in my right hand and the seven gold lampstands: The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands are the seven churches.

2.source: Drafted from the public-domain King James Version in the simple-English style of this Bible.

verses.text: Write this to the angel of the church in Ephesus: These are the words of the One who holds the seven stars in His right hand and walks among the seven gold lampstands.

I know what you do. I know your hard work and your patience. I know you cannot put up with evil people. You have tested those who claim to be apostles but are not, and you have found them to be liars.
You have kept going and have suffered for my name, and you have not given up.
But I have this against you: you have left the love you had at first.

Remember how high you once stood before you fell! Repent and return to the deeds you did at first. If you refuse to repent, I will come quickly! I will snatch away your lampstand and close your church!
But you do have this in your favor: you hate the practices of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.
Anyone who has ears should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who wins the victory, I will give the right to eat from the tree of life, which is in the paradise of God.
Write this to the angel of the church in Smyrna: These are the words of the First and the Last, the One who died and came back to life.

I know your agonizing trials and extreme poverty. Yet in reality, you are spiritually rich! I know the vicious slander spoken against you. Liars claim to be true Jews, but they are not. They are actually a gathering that belongs to Satan!

Do not fear what you are about to suffer. The devil will throw some of you into prison to test you. You will suffer intense persecution for ten days. Stay faithful, even if enemies murder your physical body! Then I will crown you with eternal life.
Anyone who has ears should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. Whoever conquers will never be harmed by the second, eternal death!
Write this to the angel of the church in Pergamum: These are the words of the One who has the sharp double-edged sword.

I know where you live: right where Satan has his ruling throne! Yet you hold tightly to my holy name. You refused to deny your faith in me. You stood firm even when they murdered Antipas, my faithful witness!

But I have a few things against you. Some of your people hold to the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to lead the people of Israel into sin, so that they ate food offered to idols and committed sexual sin.
You also have some who hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
So turn back from your sin! If you do not, I will come to you soon and fight against them with the sword of my mouth.

Anyone who has ears should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. To whoever conquers, I will give secret heavenly manna. I will also give that person a polished white stone. Engraved on that stone is a brand-new secret name! No one knows that name except the person who receives it.
Write this to the angel of the church in Thyatira: These are the words of the Son of God, whose eyes are like flames of fire and whose feet are like polished bronze.
I know what you do — your love, your faith, your service, and your patience. I know that you are doing more now than you did at first.
You tolerate that wicked woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophet! She misleads my servants into sexual sin and eating idol food.
I gave her time to repent, but she refuses to change.
So I will throw her onto a bed of agonizing sickness! I will make her unfaithful lovers suffer terrible disaster.
I will strike her children dead. Then every church will know that I examine minds and hearts! I will repay each of you according to your deeds.
Now to the rest of you in Thyatira, who do not follow her teaching and have not learned what some call the deep secrets of Satan: I will not put any other burden on you.
Just hold on to what you have until I come.
To whoever conquers and obeys my will to the end: I will give royal authority over the rebellious nations.
They will shatter them like fragile clay pots using an iron rod! They will rule just as my Father gave authority to me.
And I will also give them the radiant Morning Star!
Anyone who has ears should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.

3.source: Drafted from the public-domain King James Version in the simple-English style of this Bible.

verses.text: Write this to the angel of the church in Sardis: These are the words of the One who has the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars. I know what you do. People say you are alive, but you are dead.
Wake up! Strengthen what is left before it dies completely, because I have found that your works are not finished in the sight of my God.
So remember what you received and heard. Obey it, and turn back from your sin. If you do not wake up, I will come like a thief, and you will not know at what time I will come to you.
But you have a few people in Sardis who have kept their clothes clean. They will walk with me, dressed in white, because they are worthy.
The one who wins the victory will be dressed in white. I will never erase their name from the book of life, but I will say that they are mine in front of my Father and His angels.
Anyone who has ears should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.

Write this to the angel of the church in Philadelphia: These are the words of the One who is holy and true, who holds the key of David. What He opens, no one can shut, and what He shuts, no one can open.
I know what you do. Look, I have placed in front of you an open door that no one can shut. I know that you have only a little strength, yet you have obeyed my word and have not denied my name.
Look, I will make those who belong to Satan's group — those who claim to be Jews but are not, who are lying — come and bow down at your feet. Then they will know that I have loved you.
Because you have obeyed my command to be patient, I will keep you safe from the time of trouble that is coming on the whole world to test those who live on the earth.
I am coming soon. Hold on to what you have, so that no one takes your crown.

The one who wins the victory I will make a pillar in the temple of my God, and they will never have to leave it. I will write on them the name of my God and the name of the city of my God — the new Jerusalem, which comes down out of heaven from my God. And I will also write on them my new name.
Anyone who has ears should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
Write this to the angel of the church in Laodicea: These are the words of the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the ruler of God's creation.
I know what you do. You are neither cold nor hot. I wish you were one or the other!
But because you are lukewarm — neither hot nor cold — I am about to spit you out of my mouth.
You say: I am rich. I have everything I need. But you do not realize that you are wretched, pitiful, poor, blind, and naked.

So I advise you to buy from me gold made pure by fire, so you can be truly rich. Buy white clothes to wear, so you can cover the shame of your nakedness. And buy medicine to put on your eyes, so you can see.
I correct and discipline everyone I love. So be serious, and turn back from your sin.
Look, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in and eat with them, and they will eat with me.
To the one who wins the victory I will give the right to sit with me on my throne, just as I won the victory and sat down with my Father on His throne.
Anyone who has ears should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.

4.source: Drafted from the public-domain King James Version in the simple-English style of this Bible.

verses.text: After this I looked, and there in front of me was a door standing open in heaven. The voice I had first heard speaking to me like a trumpet said: Come up here, and I will show you what must happen after this.
At once the Spirit took hold of me. There before me was a throne in heaven, and the One seated on it blazed with breathtaking brilliance!
He radiated dazzling light like sparkling diamond and fiery ruby. A luminous green emerald rainbow circled the throne like a halo!
Around the throne were twenty-four other thrones, and on them sat twenty-four elders. They were dressed in white and had gold crowns on their heads.
From the throne came flashes of lightning, rumblings, and thunder. In front of the throne, seven torches were blazing. These are the seven Spirits of God.
In front of the throne spread a vast sea of crystal-clear glass. Surrounding the throne stood four majestic living creatures. They had eyes covering their entire bodies, seeing in every direction!
The first creature looked like a mighty lion. The second creature looked like a strong ox. The third creature had the intelligent face of a human. The fourth creature soared like a flying eagle!
Each of the four creatures had six wings. Day and night without stopping, they constantly declare: "Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God Almighty! He was, He is, and He is coming!"
The living creatures continually offer glory, honor, and thanks to God. They praise the One seated on the throne who lives forever!
Whenever they worship, the twenty-four elders fall face down before Him. They bow down and worship the One who lives forever and ever. They remove their golden crowns and cast them before His throne!

They sing: "You are worthy, our Lord and God! You deserve all glory, honor, and sovereign power! You created the entire universe and everything in it. By Your sovereign will, all things exist and were created!"

5.source: Drafted from the public-domain King James Version in the simple-English style of this Bible.

verses.text: I saw a sacred scroll in the right hand of the One on the throne. Writing covered both the front and back of the scroll. Seven wax seals locked it completely shut!
A mighty angel called out with a booming voice: "Who is worthy to break the seals and open the scroll?"
No one in heaven, on earth, or under the earth could open it. No one was even worthy to look inside!
I wept bitterly because no worthy person was found.
One of the elders told me: "Stop weeping! Look! The Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has triumphed! He is worthy to open the scroll and its seven seals."

Then I saw a Lamb standing in the center of the throne. The Lamb stood surrounded by the four living creatures and the elders. He looked as if cruel hands had slaughtered Him! Yet He stood alive, with seven horns and seven eyes. These are the sevenfold Spirits of God sent throughout the whole earth!
The Lamb stepped forward and took the scroll from God's right hand.

When He took the scroll, the four creatures and twenty-four elders bowed down. They fell flat on their faces before the Lamb! Each elder held a musical harp. They held golden bowls overflowing with sweet incense. This rising incense represents the prayers of God's holy people!

They sang a brand-new victory song to the Lamb: "You are worthy to take the scroll and break its seals! For You were slaughtered on the cross! With Your own blood, You purchased people for God. You bought people from every tribe, language, people, and nation!"
"You made them a royal kingdom of priests to serve our God. And they will reign as kings upon the earth!"
Then I looked and heard the roaring voices of countless angels. Millions upon millions surrounded the throne, creatures, and elders!
They sang in a mighty roar: "Worthy is the slaughtered Lamb to receive supreme power! He deserves divine wealth, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and blessing!"

Then I heard every creature in all creation singing. Creatures in heaven, on earth, under earth, and in the seas cried out: "To the One seated on the throne and to the Lamb: be all praise, honor, glory, and power forever and ever!"
The four living creatures said: "Amen!" And the elders fell face down and worshiped.

6.source: Drafted from the public-domain King James Version in the simple-English style of this Bible.

verses.text: Then I watched as the Lamb broke open the first of the seven seals. One of the four living creatures roared like thunder: "Ride forth!"
I looked, and there before me was a white horse. Its rider held a bow, and he was given a crown. He rode out as a winner, to win the victory.
When the Lamb broke open the second seal, the second living creature roared: "Ride forth!"
Then another horse came out, a fiery red one. Its rider was given power to take peace from the earth and to make people kill each other. He was given a large sword.
When the Lamb broke open the third seal, the third living creature roared: "Ride forth!" I looked, and there before me was a black horse. Its rider held a pair of balance scales in his hand.

A voice from among the four living creatures declared: "A full day's wage will buy only one small loaf of wheat bread! A full day's wage will buy only three small portions of coarse barley. Do not damage the luxury olive oil and wine!"
When the Lamb broke open the fourth seal, I heard the fourth living creature roar: "Ride forth!"

I looked, and there was a sickly, pale-green horse! The rider's name was Death. The Grave marched right behind him, swallowing the dead. God allowed them power over one-fourth of the earth. They slaughtered people with swords, famine, deadly plagues, and wild beasts!
When the Lamb broke open the fifth seal, I saw the souls of murdered believers under the altar. Enemies had killed them for preaching God's word and testifying about Jesus.
They cried out in a loud, booming voice: "Sovereign Lord, holy and true, how long will You wait? When will You judge the earth and avenge our shed blood?"
God gave each of them a gleaming white robe. He told them to rest and wait a little longer. More of their fellow servants and brothers must be killed, just like them!
The Lamb broke open the sixth seal! A violent earthquake shook the entire earth. The sun turned pitch-black like dark goat-hair mourning cloth. The full moon turned blood-red!
Stars fell from the sky to the earth like storm-shaken figs.
The sky tore apart and rolled up like a scroll! The quake ripped every mountain and island from its foundation.
Kings, generals, rich rulers, slaves, and free people scrambled in terror. They hid deep inside mountain caves and between rugged rocks.
They screamed to the mountains: "Collapse on top of us! Hide us from the glowing face of the One on the throne! Shield us from the fierce wrath of the Lamb!"
"For the great day of Their wrath has arrived! Who can survive standing before Them?"

7.source: Drafted from the public-domain King James Version in the simple-English style of this Bible.

verses.text: I saw four mighty angels standing at the earth's four corners. They held back the four destructive winds of the earth. They stopped any wind from blowing on land, sea, or trees!
Then I saw another angel rising from the east. He carried the official signet seal of the living God! He shouted with a booming voice to the four judgment angels:
"Do not harm the land, sea, or trees yet! Wait until we stamp God's seal on His servants' foreheads!"
Then I heard the number of those who were sealed: 144,000 from all the tribes of Israel.
From the tribe of Judah 12,000 were sealed, from the tribe of Reuben 12,000, from the tribe of Gad 12,000,
from the tribe of Asher 12,000, from the tribe of Naphtali 12,000, from the tribe of Manasseh 12,000,
from the tribe of Simeon 12,000, from the tribe of Levi 12,000, from the tribe of Issachar 12,000,
from the tribe of Zebulun 12,000, from the tribe of Joseph 12,000, and from the tribe of Benjamin 12,000.

After this, I looked, and there stood an enormous crowd! The multitude was so massive that no human could count them. They came from every nation, tribe, people group, and language. They stood before the royal throne and before the Lamb! They wore dazzling white robes and waved palm branches of victory.
They shouted with a mighty, united roar: "Salvation belongs to our God on the throne, and to the Lamb!"
All the angels stood around the throne, the elders, and the four living creatures. They fell down on their faces in front of the throne and worshiped God.
They said: Amen! Praise, glory, wisdom, thanks, honor, power, and strength belong to our God forever and ever. Amen!
Then one of the elders asked me: Who are these people dressed in white robes, and where did they come from?

I answered: "Sir, you know." The elder explained: "These believers survived the Great Tribulation. They washed their stained robes in the blood of the Lamb. And His red blood made their robes brilliantly white!"
That is why they are in front of the throne of God and serve Him day and night in His temple. And the One who sits on the throne will shelter them with His presence.
They will never suffer hunger or thirst again. Scorching sun and blistering heat will never beat down on them!
For the Lamb at the center of the throne will shepherd them. He will guide them to bubbling springs of living water. And God will tenderly wipe every single tear from their eyes!

8.source: Drafted from the public-domain King James Version in the simple-English style of this Bible.

verses.text: The Lamb broke open the seventh seal! Instantly, complete silence gripped heaven for about half an hour.
Then I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and they were given seven trumpets.

Another angel came and stood before the golden incense altar. He held a golden incense burner in his hands. He received a generous heap of sweet incense to offer. He offered it with the prayers of all God's holy people.
The fragrant incense smoke rose directly before God from the angel's hand.
Then the angel filled the burner with blazing coals from the altar. He hurled the burning fire down upon the earth! Instantly, thunder roared, lightning flashed, and a violent earthquake struck!
Then the seven angels with the seven trumpets got ready to blow them.

The first angel blasted his trumpet! Hail and fire mixed with blood rained down upon the earth. Fire devoured one-third of the earth and one-third of the trees. The blaze burned up all the green grass!
The second angel blasted his trumpet! Something like a giant burning mountain crashed into the sea. One-third of the ocean turned into thick blood!
One-third of all sea creatures died, and one-third of all ships sank.
The third angel blasted his trumpet! A massive star fell from the sky, blazing like a fiery torch. It crashed into one-third of the freshwater rivers and natural springs.
The name of this falling star is Bitterness. One-third of the fresh water turned poisonous and bitter. Many people died from drinking the poisoned water!

The fourth angel blasted his trumpet! A blow struck one-third of the sun, moon, and stars. Their light vanished, plunging one-third of the universe into black darkness. One-third of the day lost its light, and one-third of the night too.

I looked up and saw an eagle flying in midair. It shrieked with a piercing cry across the sky: "Terror! Terror! Terrible doom is coming upon earth's inhabitants! The remaining three trumpet blasts are about to sound!"

9.source: Drafted from the public-domain King James Version in the simple-English style of this Bible.

verses.text: The fifth angel blasted his trumpet! I saw a fallen star from heaven standing on earth. God handed this fallen angel the key to the bottomless pit.
He unlocked the dark shaft of the deep pit. Thick smoke poured out like the exhaust of a giant furnace! The billowing smoke blacked out the sun and the sky.
Out of the smoke, locusts came down on the earth, and they were given power like the power of scorpions.
They were told not to harm the grass of the earth or any plant or tree, but only the people who did not have the seal of God on their foreheads.
The locusts were not allowed to kill these people, but only to torture them for five months. The pain they caused was like the sting of a scorpion.
During those agonizing months, people will desperately search for death. Yet they will not find it! They will long to die, but death will run away from them.
These locusts looked like armored warhorses prepared for battle. They wore what looked like golden crowns upon their heads. Their faces resembled intelligent human faces.
Their long hair flowed like women's hair. Their sharp teeth tore like lions' teeth!
They wore chestplates of iron armor. The thundering roar of their wings sounded like charging chariots!
They possessed scorpion tails equipped with venomous stingers. Their stingers held power to torment people for five long months.
Their king was the angel of the deep pit. His name in Hebrew is Abaddon, and in Greek it is Apollyon (which means Destroyer).
The first terror is past. Two more are still to come.
The sixth angel blasted his trumpet! I heard a voice speak from the golden altar before God.
It commanded the angel: "Release the four bound angels at the Euphrates River!"
So the four execution angels were released. God kept them prepared for this exact hour, day, month, and year! They rode out to slaughter one-third of all human beings.
I heard the count of the cavalry: two hundred million mounted troops!
The riders wore armor of fiery red, smoky blue, and sulfur yellow. The horses had ferocious heads like roaring lions. Blazing fire, thick smoke, and burning sulfur belched from their mouths!
These three plagues wiped out one-third of all humanity.
The horses' power lay in their deadly mouths and their tails. Their tails were like biting venomous snakes with heads!

The surviving people still refused to turn away from their evil deeds! They kept right on worshiping demons and lifeless handmade idols. They bowed to idols of gold, silver, bronze, stone, and wood. Those idols cannot see, cannot hear, and cannot even walk!
The survivors refused to repent of their murders and witchcraft. They refused to stop their sexual immorality and stealing!

10.source: Drafted from the public-domain King James Version in the simple-English style of this Bible.

verses.text: I saw another mighty angel descending from heaven. A swirling cloud wrapped around his magnificent body. A glowing rainbow encircled his head like a halo! His face shone with the blinding brilliance of the sun. His legs blazed like towering pillars of fire!
He held a small open scroll in his hand. He planted his right foot upon the ocean waves. He planted his left foot upon the dry land!
He roared with a deafening shout like a roaring lion!
When he shouted, the voices of the seven thunders boomed! I prepared to write down their words. A voice from heaven commanded: "Seal up what the thunders said! Do not write it down!"
The mighty angel standing on sea and land raised his right hand. He swore a solemn oath by the eternal, living God!
God created the heavens, the earth, the sea, and everything in them. The angel declared: "There will be no more delay!"
"When the seventh angel blasts his trumpet, God's secret plan will finish! He will fulfill everything announced to His servants the prophets."
The heavenly voice spoke: "Go, take the scroll from the colossal angel!"
I approached the angel and asked for the little scroll. He said: "Take this scroll and eat it up! In your mouth, it will taste sweet like pure honey. In your stomach, it will turn sour and bitter!"
I took the scroll and ate it. In my mouth, it was sweet as honey. After I swallowed it, my stomach churned with bitter agony!
Then God commanded: "You must prophesy again to many nations and kings!"

11.source: Drafted from the public-domain King James Version in the simple-English style of this Bible.

verses.text: Someone handed me a wooden measuring rod like a staff. He commanded: "Go and measure the temple sanctuary of God! Measure the altar, and count the holy worshipers there."
"Do not measure the outer courtyard; leave it out completely! God handed that courtyard over to the rebellious nations. They will trample the holy city underfoot for forty-two months!"
God declared: "I will commission My two faithful witnesses. They will prophesy for 1,260 days, dressed in rough sackcloth."
These witnesses are the two olive trees and two lampstands. They stand continuously before the Lord of the earth!
If enemies try to harm them, fire blasts from their mouths! That holy fire devours their enemies completely. Anyone trying to harm them must die that exact way!

These two prophets have authority to lock the sky. No rain will fall while they preach their message! They have authority to turn water into thick blood. They can strike the earth with plagues whenever they wish!
When they finish their testimony, the beast from the abyss will attack! The monster will conquer them and slaughter them.
Their dead bodies will lie exposed in the city street. That wicked city is spiritually called Sodom and Egypt. It is the same city where their Lord was crucified.
For three and a half days, people from every nation will gawk at them. They will refuse to let their corpses be buried in graves!
Earth's inhabitants will rejoice, celebrate, and send each other gifts. They will celebrate because these two prophets tormented them!
After three and a half days, God's breath of life entered them! They stood upright on their own feet! Terrifying dread gripped everyone watching them.
A booming voice from heaven shouted: "Come up here!" The two witnesses ascended into heaven inside a cloud! Their enemies stood watching them disappear into the sky.

At that exact moment, a violent earthquake struck the city. One-tenth of the city collapsed in ruins. Seven thousand people were crushed to death in the quake. The terrified survivors gave glory to the God of heaven!
The second terror is past. The third terror is coming soon.
The seventh angel blasted his trumpet! Loud voices in heaven thundered: "The kingdom of this world has become the kingdom of our Lord and of His Christ! And He will reign as King forever and ever!"
The twenty-four elders fell face down before God and worshiped:
"We give You thanks, Lord God Almighty! You are the One who is and who always was. You took Your supreme power and began Your glorious reign!"

"The rebellious nations raged with fury, but Your wrath has arrived! The appointed time has come to judge the dead. It is time to reward Your servants the prophets and Your holy people. You will reward everyone who honors Your name, small and great! And You will destroy the wicked who destroy the earth!"
Then God's temple in heaven swung open wide! Inside the temple stood the sacred Ark of His Covenant. Lightning flashed, thunder crashed, and a terrible hailstorm struck!

12.source: Drafted from the public-domain King James Version in the simple-English style of this Bible.

verses.text: A magnificent sign appeared in the heavens! A glorious woman stood clothed with the brilliant sun. The glowing moon rested under her feet. A royal crown of twelve stars circled her head.
She was pregnant and cried out in intense labor pain. She groaned in agony as she prepared to give birth.
Then another startling sign appeared across heaven. Look! A monstrous fiery red dragon appeared! He had seven heads, ten horns, and seven royal crowns.

His massive tail swept one-third of the stars from heaven. He hurled them violently down to the earth! The dragon crouched directly in front of the laboring woman. He intended to devour her baby the instant it was born!
She gave birth to a Son, a male Child. He is destined to rule all nations with an iron rod! Suddenly, God snatched the Child straight up to His throne!
The woman ran away into the desert, to a place God had prepared for her, where she would be taken care of for 1,260 days.
Then violent war erupted in heaven! Michael and his holy angels fought against the dragon. The dragon and his rebellious angels fought back fiercely.
The dragon lost the war, and heaven evicted them!

Heaven threw that massive monster violently down to earth. He is that ancient serpent called the devil, or Satan. He is the deceiver who misleads the entire world. God hurled him and his fallen angels down to the earth!

A thundering voice in heaven declared: "Now God's salvation, power, and eternal kingdom have arrived! The supreme authority of His Christ has come! For the prosecutor accusing our brothers and sisters has been cast down! He accused them before our God day and night."
"Our brothers and sisters conquered him by the blood of the Lamb! They conquered him by the word of their bold testimony. They did not love their physical lives even facing death!"
"Rejoice, you heavens, and everyone who lives there! Terror strikes the earth and the sea! The devil plunged down to you, burning with furious rage. He knows his remaining time is very short!"
The dragon realized God had thrown him down to earth. So he pursued the woman who bore the male Child.

God gave the woman two powerful wings of a great eagle. She flew into the desert to her prepared place of safety. There God nourishes her for three and a half years. She stays completely safe from the serpent's reach!
The serpent spewed a torrent of water like a raging river. He tried to sweep her away in the flood!
The earth helped the woman and opened wide its mouth. The ground swallowed the river the dragon spewed!
Enraged, the dragon went off to wage war against her remaining children. They are the believers who obey God and hold fast to Jesus!

13.source: Drafted from the public-domain King James Version in the simple-English style of this Bible.

verses.text: I stood watching on the sandy seashore. A terrifying beast rose up out of the sea! It had ten horns and seven heads. Ten royal crowns sat upon its horns. Blasphemous names insulting God were carved on each head!
The monster resembled a spotted leopard. It had massive paws like a bear and a mouth like a roaring lion. The dragon gave this beast his power, throne, and vast authority!
One of its heads suffered a fatal death wound. Yet the deadly wound healed completely! The whole world was stunned and followed the beast in awe.
People worshiped the dragon because he had given his authority to the beast. They also worshiped the beast and said: Who is like the beast? Who can fight against it?
The beast opened its mouth to utter arrogant boasts and blasphemies! God permitted it to exert authority for forty-two months.
It spewed vicious insults against God and His holy name! It insulted His heavenly sanctuary and all who dwell in heaven.
God allowed the beast to wage war against His holy people. The beast conquered them and ruled over every nation, tribe, and tongue!
All who live on the earth will worship the beast — everyone whose name has not been written in the Lamb's book of life since the creation of the world. The Lamb is the one who was killed.
Anyone who has ears should listen.
Whoever is destined for prison will go into prison! Whoever is destined to die by the sword will be killed. This demands patient endurance and unwavering faith from God's holy people!
Then I saw a second beast rising up out of the earth! It had two horns like a gentle lamb, but it spoke like a dragon.
It wielded all the authority of the first beast on its behalf. It forced the whole earth to worship the first healed beast.
This second beast performed astonishing supernatural miracles! It even called blazing fire down from heaven before crowds of people.
It deceived earth's inhabitants through these supernatural signs. It ordered people to build a giant statue honoring the beast!
The false prophet received power to breathe life into the statue! The statue began to speak with a booming voice. It commanded the execution of anyone refusing to worship it!
The beast forced every single person to take a mark. It stamped the small, great, rich, poor, free, and slave! They had to receive this brand on their right hand or forehead.
No one could buy groceries or sell goods without that official mark! The mark is the name of the beast or its code number.
This requires sharp spiritual wisdom! Let anyone with understanding calculate the beast's number. It is the number of a human being. His number is 666!

14.source: Drafted from the public-domain King James Version in the simple-English style of this Bible.

verses.text: I looked, and there stood the Lamb on holy Mount Zion! Standing with Him were 144,000 sealed believers. His name and His Father's name were engraved upon their foreheads!
I heard a roaring sound from heaven like crashing ocean waters. It sounded like rolling thunder and harpists strumming their harps.
They sang a brand-new victory song before the throne! No one could learn that song except the 144,000 redeemed believers.
They kept themselves spiritually pure from all idol corruption. They follow the Lamb wherever He leads them. Jesus purchased them from among humanity as a holy firstfruits offering!
No deceit was ever found in their speech; they stand blameless.
I saw another angel flying high across midair. He carried the eternal Gospel to preach to earth's inhabitants. He announced it to every nation, tribe, language, and people!
He shouted: "Fear God and give Him glory! The hour of His divine judgment has arrived! Worship the Creator who made the heavens, earth, and waters!"
A second angel followed, shouting: "Fallen! Babylon the Great has fallen! She made all nations drink the intoxicating wine of her immorality!"
A third angel followed, shouting with a booming voice: "Whoever worships the beast and receives its brand mark,"

"they will drink the undiluted wine of God's fierce fury! God poured His wrath full strength into the cup of indignation. They will endure agonizing torment in fire and burning sulfur! The Lamb and holy angels will witness their punishment."
"The suffocating smoke of their torment rises forever and ever! There is no rest day or night for those who worship the beast and its image, or for anyone who receives the mark of its name."
This calls for patient endurance from God's holy people, who obey His commands and stay faithful to Jesus.

Then I heard a voice from heaven say: Write this: From now on, blessed are the dead who die belonging to the Lord. Yes, says the Spirit, they will rest from their hard work, for what they have done goes with them.
I looked, and there floated a pure white cloud! Seated upon the cloud was Someone like the Son of Man. He wore a golden royal crown upon His head. He held a razor-sharp harvest sickle in His hand!
An angel emerged from the heavenly temple, crying out: "Swing Your sharp sickle and reap the harvest! The appointed hour has come; earth's grain crop is ripe!"
So the Son of Man swung His sickle across the earth. And He gathered earth's grain harvest to Himself!
Then another angel came out of the heavenly temple. He also held a razor-sharp curved sickle.
A third angel, who held authority over fire, came from the altar. He shouted: "Swing your sickle and gather earth's ripe grape clusters!"
The angel swung his sickle and cut down earth's heavy vineyard. He hurled the grape clusters into the massive winepress of God's fury!
Enemies stomped the winepress outside the holy city. A terrifying river of blood gushed out of the press! The blood surged as high as horses' bridles for 180 miles!

15.source: Drafted from the public-domain King James Version in the simple-English style of this Bible.

verses.text: Then I saw another sign in heaven, great and amazing: seven angels with the seven last plagues. With these the anger of God is finished.

I saw what looked like a vast sea of crystal glass. Blazing streaks of fiery light mixed through the glass! Standing upon the glass were the champions who conquered the beast. They defeated the beast, its statue, and its code number! God placed golden harps into their hands.

They sang the victory song of Moses, God's servant. They sang the triumphant song of the Lamb: "Great and breathtaking are Your mighty works, Lord God Almighty! Righteous and true are all Your ways, King of the nations!"
"Who will not revere You, Lord, and glorify Your name? For You alone are holy! All nations will come and bow down in worship before You. For Your righteous judgments stand fully revealed!"
After this, I looked, and heaven's temple opened wide! The inner sanctuary of the covenant tent stood open.
The seven angels holding the seven plagues marched out. They wore pure, brilliant white linen robes. Wide golden sashes wrapped around their chests.
One of the four living creatures approached the seven angels. He handed them seven golden bowls full of God's burning wrath! This wrath belongs to God, who lives forever and ever.

Billowing smoke filled the entire temple! The smoke came from God's glorious presence and awesome power. No one could enter the temple sanctuary. The doors stayed closed until the angels finished all seven plagues!

16.source: Drafted from the public-domain King James Version in the simple-English style of this Bible.

verses.text: Then I heard a loud voice from the temple say to the seven angels: Go and pour out on the earth the seven bowls of God's anger.
The first angel poured his bowl onto the earth. Painful, foul-smelling sores broke out on people who took the beast's mark! Sores broke out on everyone who worshiped its image.
The second angel poured his bowl into the sea. The ocean turned into thick, rotting blood like a corpse! Every single living creature in the sea died.
The third angel poured his bowl onto the rivers and springs. All the fresh drinking water turned into blood!
The angel of the waters declared: "You are righteous, O Holy One!"
"They murdered Your holy people and Your prophets. Now You have given them blood to drink! They got exactly what they deserve!"
And I heard the altar respond: Yes, Lord God Almighty, your judgments are true and right.
The fourth angel poured his bowl onto the blazing sun. The sun scorched people with intense, raging heat!
Blistering heat burned their flesh, and they cursed God's holy name. God held sovereign power over these plagues! Yet the wicked refused to repent and give Him glory.
The fifth angel poured his bowl on the beast's throne. Thick darkness plunged over the beast's entire kingdom! People bit their tongues in excruciating agony.
They cursed the God of heaven for their sores and pain. Still, they stubbornly refused to repent of their evil deeds!
The sixth angel poured his bowl on the great Euphrates River. Its waters dried up completely, opening a highway for eastern kings.
Then I saw three foul spirits looking like slimy frogs! They leaped out from the mouths of the unholy trinity: from the dragon's mouth, the beast's mouth, and the false prophet's mouth.
They are demonic spirits performing deceptive signs. They muster the kings of the world for battle! They gather them for the great day of God Almighty.
"Look! I am coming unexpectedly like a stealthy thief! Blessed is the person who stays awake and remains spiritually clothed!"
The demonic spirits assembled the armies at the place called Armageddon.
The seventh angel poured his bowl into the air. A thundering voice roared from the throne in the temple: "It is finished!"
Lightning flashed, thunder crashed, and a catastrophic earthquake struck. No earthquake so violent has ever shaken humanity before!

The great city split into three distinct pieces. The cities of the nations collapsed into ruins! God remembered Babylon the Great and handed her the cup. He forced her to drink the wine of His furious wrath!
Every island vanished into the sea, and mountains flattened out.
Giant hundred-pound hailstones hammered people from the sky. And people cursed God for the devastating plague of hail!

17.source: Drafted from the public-domain King James Version in the simple-English style of this Bible.

verses.text: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls came and said to me: Come, I will show you how the great prostitute will be judged — the one who sits on many waters.
The kings of the earth committed sexual sin with her, and the people of the earth got drunk on the wine of her sinful ways.

The angel carried me away in the Spirit into a barren desert. I saw a woman sitting astride a scarlet beast. Blasphemous names insulting God covered the entire beast! The monster had seven ferocious heads and ten horns.
The woman wore luxurious royal robes of purple and scarlet. She glittered with expensive gold, sparkling gems, and pearls! She held a golden cup filled with filthy, disgusting abominations.
A mysterious name was branded across her forehead: "Babylon the Great, mother of prostitutes and earthly abominations!"

I saw that the woman was staggering drunk! She was drunk on the blood of God's holy people. She drank the blood of faithful martyrs who testified about Jesus. When I saw her, I was stunned with total shock!
The angel asked: "Why are you paralyzed with shock? I will explain the hidden secret of the woman and the beast!"

The beast you saw once lived, but now is gone. Yet it will soon climb out of the bottomless abyss! Then it will march straight into eternal destruction. Unsaved earth dwellers will marvel when they see the beast. Their names were never recorded in the Book of Life! They will marvel because the beast was, is not, and will appear!
This calls for a mind with wisdom. The seven heads are seven hills on which the woman sits. They are also seven kings.
Five kings have fallen, one is ruling now, and the other has not yet come. When he does come, he must remain for only a little while.
The beast that once was, and now is not, is itself an eighth king. It belongs with the seven and is going to its destruction.
The ten horns represent ten allied kings who have not yet reigned. They will receive royal authority for one brief hour alongside the beast.
These kings share one single purpose: they surrender their sovereign power and military might to the beast.

Together, they will wage war against the Lamb! But the Lamb will crush and conquer them completely! For He is Lord of lords and King of kings! Standing with Him are His called, chosen, and faithful followers!
Then the angel said to me: The waters you saw, where the prostitute sits, are peoples, crowds, nations, and languages.
The beast and the ten horns will violently hate the prostitute. They will strip her naked and leave her utterly ruined! They will devour her flesh and incinerate her with fire!
God put it into their hearts to execute His divine plan. They will unite and surrender their kingdom to the beast. They will rule until every word of God is completely fulfilled!
The woman you saw represents the corrupt world city. She reigns supreme over all the rulers of the earth.

18.source: Drafted from the public-domain King James Version in the simple-English style of this Bible.

verses.text: After this I saw another angel coming down from heaven. He had great authority, and the earth was made bright by his glory.
He shouted in a powerful voice: "Fallen! Babylon the Great has fallen completely! She has become a dark haunt for demons. Every foul spirit and filthy, scavenger bird roosts in her ruins!"
For all the nations have drunk the wine of her wild and sinful ways. The kings of the earth committed sexual sin with her, and the merchants of the earth grew rich from her great luxury.
Then I heard another voice from heaven say: "Come out of her, My people! You must not share in her sins. You must not receive any of her plagues!"
For her sins are piled up as high as heaven, and God has remembered her crimes.
Pay her back the way she paid others. Give her double for what she has done. Mix her a double share in her own cup.
Give her as much torture and sorrow as the glory and luxury she gave herself. In her heart she says: I sit as a queen. I am not a widow, and I will never grieve.
Because of this, her plagues will come in a single day — death, sorrow, and famine. She will be burned up with fire, because the Lord God who judges her is powerful.
World kings will weep when they see smoke from her burning. Terrified by her agonizing torment, they will stand far off.
They will cry: "Disaster! Disaster upon the mighty city of Babylon! In one single hour, your terrifying judgment arrived!"
Earthly merchants weep and mourn over her. No one buys their luxury cargo anymore!
No one buys their gold, silver, pearls, and jewels. No one buys their fine linen, purple silk, and scarlet cloth. No one purchases their costly ivory, scented wood, bronze, or marble.
No one buys their spices, wine, olive oil, and fine wheat. No one buys their horses, royal carriages, and livestock. And no one buys human slaves — trafficked human souls!
They will say: The fruit you longed for is gone from you. All your riches and splendor have vanished, never to be found again.
The merchants will stand far off, terrified by her torment.
They will wail: "Disaster! In one single hour, your vast wealth vanished!"
Ship captains, sailors, and traders will watch from the sea.
They will throw dust on their heads, weeping in bitter grief!

They will throw dust on their heads, and with crying and mourning they will shout: Disaster! Disaster on you, great city, where all who had ships on the sea grew rich from her wealth! In one hour she has been destroyed.
Be glad over her, you heavens! Be glad, you holy people, apostles, and prophets! For God has judged her for the way she treated you.

A mighty angel picked up a stone the size of a giant millstone. He hurled it violently down into the crashing ocean! He shouted: "With such violent force, mighty Babylon will be thrown down! She will never be found on earth again!"

The sweet music of harps, flutes, and trumpets will go dead silent. No craftsman or worker of any trade will work in you again. The sound of household millstones grinding grain will never be heard again.
The warm light of a lamp will never shine in you again. The joyful voices of brides and grooms will never echo again. For your corrupt merchants ruled the earth with deceptive witchcraft!
In her ruins was found the shed blood of God's holy prophets!

19.source: Drafted from the public-domain King James Version in the simple-English style of this Bible.

verses.text: I heard what sounded like a massive crowd roaring in heaven: "Hallelujah! Salvation, glory, and sovereign power belong to our God!"
"His judicial sentences are completely true and righteous. He judged the notorious prostitute who corrupted the earth! He avenged the shed blood of His faithful servants!"
Again the heavenly choir shouted: "Hallelujah! Her dense smoke rises up forever and ever!"
The twenty-four elders and four living creatures fell face down. They worshiped God seated upon the royal throne, crying: "Amen! Hallelujah!"
Then a voice came from the throne, saying: Praise our God, all you His servants, all you who honor Him, both small and great!
Then I heard what sounded like a huge crowd, like the roar of rushing waters and loud peals of thunder, shouting: Hallelujah! For our Lord God Almighty reigns.
Let us celebrate with boundless joy and give Him glory! For the glorious wedding of the Lamb has arrived! His holy Bride has prepared herself for Him.
God clothed her in fine linen, dazzling and clean. That fine linen represents the righteous deeds of God's saints.
The angel said: "Write this: Blessed are those invited to the Lamb's wedding feast!" And he added: "These are the true words of God."

I fell down at his feet to worship him. But he said to me: Do not do that! I am a fellow servant with you and with your brothers and sisters who hold to the truth about Jesus. Worship God! For the truth about Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.
I saw heaven standing wide open before my eyes! Look! A magnificent white stallion appeared! Its Rider is named Faithful and True. He judges and wages war with absolute righteousness.
His eyes blaze like leaping flames of fire! Many royal crowns rest upon His head. He carries a written name known only to Himself.
He wears a royal robe dipped in blood! His holy title is the Word of God.
Heaven's armies followed Him on white horses, wearing pure linen.
A sharp battle sword proceeds from His mouth to strike the nations. He will shepherd rebellious rulers with an iron rod. He treads the winepress of God Almighty's burning fury!
On His robe and thigh is written: KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS!
I saw an angel standing in the radiant sun. He shouted with a booming voice to all flying birds: "Come! Assemble together for the great banquet supper of God!"
"Feast upon the flesh of kings, generals, and mighty warriors! Gorge on horses, riders, free men, slaves, small and great!"
The beast and world armies gathered to fight the Rider and His army.
Christ captured the beast and the deceitful false prophet! He threw both of them alive into the sulfurous lake of fire!
His spoken sword slaughtered the rest of their rebellious armies. And all the scavenger birds gorged themselves upon their dead flesh!
I saw an angel descending from heaven. He held the key to the bottomless abyss. He carried a massive iron chain in his hand.
The angel seized the dragon, that ancient serpent! He is the devil, Satan himself. The angel bound him securely for one thousand years.

He hurled the dragon headfirst into the deep abyss! He shut the hatch and locked it with a seal. Satan could no longer deceive the nations for one thousand years. Afterward, he must be released for a short time.

I saw royal thrones, and rulers sat upon them. God gave them divine authority to execute judgment! I saw the souls of believers executed for their faith. Enemies had beheaded them for testifying about Jesus and God's word. They refused to worship the beast or its statue. They rejected its mark on their foreheads or hands. They came back to life and ruled with Christ for one thousand years!
The rest of the dead did not live until the thousand years ended. This is the glorious first resurrection!

Blessed and holy are those sharing in this first resurrection! The second death holds zero power over them. They will serve as priests of God and of Christ! They will reign alongside Him for one thousand years.
When the thousand years end, God will release Satan. He will crawl out of his subterranean prison.
He will deceive the nations across the earth — Gog and Magog. Satan will gather them together for an all-out battle. Their soldiers will outnumber the grains of sand on the seashore!
They marched across the earth and surrounded the camp of God's saints. They encircled the beloved holy city of Jerusalem. Suddenly, blazing fire rained down from heaven and consumed them!
God threw the devil into the lake of burning sulfur! The beast and false prophet were already burning there. They will suffer agonizing torment day and night forever and ever!
I saw a magnificent Great White Throne. I saw God seated in royal majesty upon it. The earth and sky vanished before His blazing face! No place was found for them anywhere.

I saw the dead, both great and small, standing before God. Angels unrolled the heavenly record books before the throne. Another scroll was opened: the Lamb's Book of Life! God judged the dead according to their recorded deeds.
The sea gave up the dead bodies inside it. Death and the Grave surrendered the dead within them. God judged every single person according to what they did.
Then God threw Death and the Grave into the lake of fire! This lake of fire is the final, second death.
Anyone whose name was missing from the Book of Life: God threw them straight into the lake of fire!

20.source: Drafted from the public-domain King James Version, checked against the Greek text (Strong's Concordance / Blue Letter Bible) for word accuracy. V12 fixed a stray mid-sentence capital and grammar. V13-14 fixed 'hell' to 'the grave' -- this is Hades (the realm of the dead), not Gehenna, per the site's established rule; the original wording was also confusing, since it implied 'Hell' and 'the lake of fire' were the same thing being thrown into itself. Number formatting standardized ('1 000' to '1,000').

21.source: Drafted from the public-domain King James Version in the simple-English style of this Bible.

verses.text: I saw a brand-new heaven and a brand-new earth! The first heaven and the first earth vanished away. And the chaotic ocean sea existed no more!
I saw the holy city, the New Jerusalem, descending from God. It shone with beauty, like a bride prepared for her husband.

A thundering voice roared from the throne: "Look! God's permanent dwelling place is now directly among human beings! He will live together with them, and they will be His people. God Himself will dwell among them as their God!"

"He will gently wipe away every tear from their crying eyes. Death will never strike again, and sorrow will be no more! Crying and agonizing pain will vanish forever, because the former order of suffering has passed away!"
The One seated on the throne declared: "Look! I am making all things brand-new!" He commanded: "Write this down, because these words are true and faithful!"

He said to me: "It is accomplished! I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. To anyone who is thirsty, I will give water freely! They will drink without cost from the spring of living water."
"Whoever conquers will inherit all these glorious blessings. I will be their God, and they will be My beloved child!"

"But cowards, unbelievers, murderers, and the corrupt will face judgment. Sexually immoral people, occult sorcerers, idol worshipers, and all liars: their final place is the lake of burning sulfur! This lake of fire is the irreversible second death."
Then one of the seven angels who had the seven bowls full of the seven last plagues came to me and said: Come, I will show you the bride, the wife of the Lamb.
He carried me away in the Spirit to a great, high mountain and showed me the holy city, Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God.
It shone with the glory of God. Its brightness was like a very precious jewel, like a jasper stone, clear as crystal.
It had a great, high wall with twelve gates, and at the gates were twelve angels. On the gates were written the names of the twelve tribes of Israel.
There were three gates on the east, three on the north, three on the south, and three on the west.
The wall of the city had twelve foundation stones, and on them were the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.
The angel carried a golden measuring rod to survey the city. He measured its foundations, its massive gates, and its high walls.
The city was laid out as a perfect square. Its length, width, and height were exactly equal! The angel measured the city: fourteen hundred miles long, wide, and high!
He measured the perimeter wall: two hundred sixteen feet thick. The angel used standard human measurements to survey the wall.
The city wall was built with radiant crystalline jasper. The city itself was pure gold, translucent like polished glass!
Twelve distinct precious gemstones decorated the city's foundation layers. The foundations displayed jasper, sapphire, chalcedony, emerald, and onyx.
They sparkled with carnelian, chrysolite, beryl, topaz, chrysoprase, jacinth, and amethyst.
The twelve gates were crafted from twelve giant pearls. Each individual gate was carved out of one single pearl! The central avenue of the city was transparent, pure gold.
I searched for a temple building, but saw none! The Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are its living temple!
The city has no need for sunlight or moonlight to shine. God's radiant glory illuminates the city, and the Lamb is its lamp!
The redeemed nations will walk forward in its glorious light. Earthly kings will carry their honor and glory into it.
Its pearl gates will never close during the day. And night will never exist inside that city!
The glory and honor of the nations will be brought into it.
Nothing defiled, disgusting, or deceptive will ever cross its gates. Only those recorded in the Lamb's Book of Life will enter!

22.source: Drafted from the public-domain King James Version in the simple-English style of this Bible.

verses.text: The angel showed me the crystal-clear river of the water of life. It flowed out directly from the throne of God and of the Lamb!

The river surged down the center of the city's golden street. On both sides of the river stood the lush Tree of Life. It yields twelve crops of fruit, ripening a fresh harvest every month! The leaves of the tree bring continuous health and healing to the nations.
No destructive curse will ever exist anywhere in the city! The throne of God and of the Lamb will stand in the city. His faithful servants will worship and serve Him continually.
They will gaze directly upon His glorious face! And His holy name will shine brightly on their foreheads.

Night will never fall upon that city again. They will need no artificial lamp or natural sunlight. For the Lord God Himself will flood them with divine light! And they will reign as royal kings forever and ever!
Then the angel said to me: These words are trustworthy and true. The Lord, the God who inspires the prophets, sent His angel to show His servants what must soon happen.
Look, I am coming soon! Blessed is the one who obeys the words of the prophecy in this book.
I, John, am the eyewitness who heard and saw these magnificent things. I fell down to worship at the feet of the revealing angel.
He stopped me: "Do not do that! Worship God alone! I am a fellow servant with you and your prophet brothers."
Then he told me: Do not keep secret the words of the prophecy in this book, because the time is near.
Let the one who does wrong keep doing wrong, and let the filthy person keep being filthy. Let the one who does right keep doing right, and let the holy person keep being holy.
Look, I am coming soon! I am bringing my reward with me, to give to each person according to what they have done.
I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the beginning and the end.
Blessed are those who obey His commands, so that they may have the right to the tree of life and may go through the gates into the city.
Outside are the dogs, those who practice witchcraft, those who commit sexual sin, the murderers, the idol worshipers, and everyone who loves and practices lying.
I, Jesus, have sent my angel to tell you these things for the churches. I am the Root and the Offspring of David, and the bright Morning Star.
The Spirit and the bride say: Come! Let the one who hears say: Come! Let anyone who is thirsty come, and let anyone who wishes take the free gift of the water of life.
I warn everyone who hears the words of the prophecy in this book: If anyone adds anything to them, God will add to that person the plagues described in this book.
And if anyone takes away any words from this book of prophecy, God will take away that person's share in the tree of life and in the holy city, which are described in this book.
The One who tells these things says: Yes, I am coming soon. Amen. Come, Lord Jesus!
May the grace of the Lord Jesus be with all of God's people. Amen.
